collection.title: Mercedes-Benz S Class Coupe 1999 to 2005 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Mercedes-Benz S Class Coupe 1999 to 2005 (C215) requires a 28" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side, all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Side Pin arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
